title: Who will score Bangladesh's first men's Test century on Australian soil?
background: A Test century is an individual score of at least 100 runs in a single innings. No Bangladesh batter has yet achieved this milestone in a men's Test played in Australia.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Test match scorecards and contemporaneous reputable cricket reporting confirming the first such century.
  • Resolution Condition: The question resolves when a player representing Bangladesh first reaches 100 runs in a single innings of an official men's Test match played in Australia.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The batter's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: sweep Aug4: The Darwin Test squad (Jul 27) leaves out Litton Das (injured, first Test only) and Mahmudul Hasan Joy, and recalls Soumya Sarkar; the batters are Shanto, Shadman, Tanzid, Mominul, Mushfiqur, Amite, Jaker and Mehidy. Bangladesh climbed to 4th in the WTC after beating Pakistan at home (ICC, Jul 31). The resolution date is Aug 14, so effectively only days 1-2 of the first Test (Aug 13-17) count.

title: Which club will lead Major League Soccer's Eastern Conference at the end of play on August 19, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official MLS Eastern Conference standings, applying the league's official tiebreaking rules if necessary
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-19 (after all matches dated August 19, 2026)
  • Accepted Answer Format: The club's name
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: sweep Aug4: Both clubs drew 2-2 on Aug 1 (Nashville at DC United, Miami v Columbus), leaving Nashville on 40 pts (12W) and Miami on 38 (11W), each after 18 games. Each has only two MLS games before the deadline: Nashville v Miami at Geodis Park on Aug 15, then Nashville at NY Red Bulls and Miami at Philadelphia on Aug 19. Miami have Messi back (Aug 1) and signed Casemiro; scenario math gives Miami about 30%.

title: Which Indonesian province will be struck by the country's deadliest earthquake between January 1 and August 17, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the province identified as the location of Indonesia's deadliest earthquake occurring from January 1 through August 17, 2026. Determine the deadliest earthquake using fatalities reported by Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency as of August 17, 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the province's name.
last_rationale: cap <.8 (window to Aug 17; deadliest so far only 3 deaths)

title: Who will win the women's 50m freestyle at the 2026 Pan Pacific Swimming Championships?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official championship results published by the organizers or World Aquatics, corroborated by contemporaneous sports reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the swimmer awarded the gold medal in the women's 50m freestyle at the 2026 Pan Pacific Swimming Championships, once the final result is announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The swimmer's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: sweep Aug4: Gretchen Walsh set the 50 free world record (23.55, Jun 28) and won US Nationals in 23.60 (Aug 1) in the same Irvine pool that hosts Pan Pacs (Aug 12-15), 0.45s ahead of the next best. Kate Douglass (23.59 in June) has ruled out swimming all three of her Aug 15 events (200 IM, 50 free, 200 breast), and Swimming World says Walsh is 'favored regardless'. Reigning world champion Meg Harris won the CWG 50/100 free (late July).

title: Who will leave UFC 330 as the UFC women's strawweight champion?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UFC's official event results and championship recognition, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the fighter recognized as the undisputed UFC women's strawweight champion immediately after the division's title bout at UFC 330. Use the fight-night outcome, excluding subsequent title changes or reversals.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The champion's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: sweep Aug4: The UFC 330 card is intact as of Aug 4, with Dern -225 and Robertson +190 at BetOnline (about 67% for Dern no-vig, up from about 62% at the open). Dern also keeps the belt if the bout falls through.

title: Who will win the welterweight championship main event at UFC 330?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UFC's official event results, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the fighter officially declared the winner of the welterweight championship main event at UFC 330. Use the result announced on fight night, excluding any subsequent reversal.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning fighter's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: sweep Aug4: The UFC 330 main event is intact, with Makhachev -335 and Garry +275 at BetOnline on Aug 4 (about 74% no-vig, slightly down from -365/+300 at the open). There is a small risk of an opponent change.

title: Who will win the women's 800m freestyle at the 2026 Pan Pacific Swimming Championships?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official championship results published by the organizers or World Aquatics, corroborated by contemporaneous sports reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the swimmer awarded the gold medal in the women's 800m freestyle at the 2026 Pan Pacific Swimming Championships, once the final result is announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The swimmer's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: sweep Aug4: Pallister won 400/800/1500 at the Commonwealth Games (800 in 8:11.12 on Jul 28 after going out under WR pace; 400 in 3:59.56), so she is in solid but not breakthrough form. Ledecky skipped US Nationals to prepare for Pan Pacs and has an unbeaten major-meet 800 record (8:08.57 in March). The women's 800 is on Aug 15, the same day as the 200 IM, and McIntosh dropped the 800 at Canadian trials and skipped Glasgow, so she is unlikely to swim it.

title: Which club will win the 2026 FA Community Shield?
background: The FA Community Shield is English football's traditional curtain-raiser ahead of the domestic league season.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Football Association's official match result or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the result.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the club that wins the 2026 FA Community Shield, including a victory by penalty shootout if applicable.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning club's name.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: sweep Aug4: The Shield is on Aug 16 at Cardiff's Principality Stadium. Arsenal are 2025-26 PL champions with squad continuity. City are under new manager Maresca, have lost Stones, Bernardo and Ake, have Rodri out after back surgery, and drew 1-1 with Inter before losing the shootout on Aug 1. Previews give Arsenal a slight edge.

title: Who will win the 2026 St Jude Championship on the PGA Tour?
background: The St Jude Championship is the opening tournament of the PGA Tour's FedEx Cup playoffs.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The PGA Tour's official final results for the 2026 St Jude Championship.
  • Resolution: The question resolves when the tournament concludes and its champion is officially determined, including any playoff if required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning golfer's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: sweep Aug4: McIlroy (world No. 2) is set to skip the St Jude and BMW and go straight to the Tour Championship (Irish Times, Jul 20), so he is dropped. FedEx standings (Aug 3) are Scheffler 1st, Fitzpatrick 2nd and Young 3rd (world No. 3). Scheffler was 2nd at the 3M Open (Jul 26) and Schauffele 2nd at the Rocket Classic (Aug 2).

title: Which country will finish top of Pool D at the 2026 men's Hockey World Cup?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official tournament standings for Pool D, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve once all Pool D matches in the initial pool stage have concluded in August 2026. Use the country ranked first under the tournament's official standings and tiebreaking rules.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the country finishing first in Pool D.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: sweep Aug4: Pool D in Amstelveen runs Aug 15 (India v Wales, England v Pakistan), Aug 17 (India v England) and Aug 19 (England v Wales, Pakistan v India). Both sides struggled in the Pro League (India 8th of 9; England narrowly avoided relegation) and drew 2-2 on Jun 25, so this is close to a coin flip decided by India v England or goal difference.

title: Which broad demand component will contribute most to Japan's quarter-on-quarter GDP growth in April–June 2026?
background: Japan's Cabinet Office publishes quarterly GDP estimates, including a breakdown of demand components' contributions to growth.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Cabinet Office's August 2026 release of Japan's April–June 2026 GDP estimates. Use that release's figures rather than subsequent revisions.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Resolve to the top-level demand component with the largest percentage-point contribution to Japan's quarter-on-quarter GDP growth for April–June 2026. Answer with the component's standard name.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: sweep Aug4: The JRI preview (Jul 31) sees Q2 GDP +0.4% q/q, with external demand +0.3pp against domestic demand of about +0.1pp, because national oil reserve drawdowns cut public inventories by 0.2pp. Daiwa (Jul 31) sees +0.7% q/q, driven by consumption and an import drop from the Hormuz closure. June crude import volumes were still -13.7% y/y.

title: Who will be appointed to succeed Pape Thiaw as head coach of Senegal's men's national football team by August 31, 2026?
background: The Senegalese Football Federation is responsible for appointing the national team's head coach.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official announcement by the Senegalese Football Federation, as confirmed by contemporaneous reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the person publicly announced as Pape Thiaw's successor between August 1 and August 31, 2026. The resolution date is the date the appointment is publicly announced, rather than the coach's presentation or first match.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointed coach's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: Aug 3-4: journalist Malang Sané, AfricaSoccer and Afrik-foot report an FSF-Vieira agreement after Vieira presented his project in Dakar. They say the announcement is delayed by Thiaw's compensation, with DTN Souleymane Diallo as a possible interim for September. L'Observateur (Aug 4) says there has been no official meeting yet and the FSF is sending a Vieira/Daf/Renard shortlist to the Sports Ministry, whose sign-off could take weeks. Renard is heading to Côte d'Ivoire, so an August announcement is not assured.

title: Who will President Donald Trump nominate in 2026 to succeed Marty Makary as FDA commissioner?
background: Marty Makary resigned as commissioner of the US Food and Drug Administration in May 2026, leaving the position vacant. The president nominates the commissioner, subject to Senate confirmation.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official presidential announcement or reliable news reporting directly quoting that announcement.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the first person President Trump publicly announces as his nominee for FDA commissioner after Makary’s May 2026 resignation and before the end of 2026. The nomination announcement is sufficient; Senate confirmation is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The nominee’s full name.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: As of Jul 20-21 (FDA Group, Tech Insider) no nominee had been named. The three STAT finalists (Overton, Ferrara, Vacirca) are still under White House review, and the pick is expected to be announced alongside new CBER/CDER heads. No newer reports were found through Aug 4. I dropped the implausible Sharpless and moved his weight to acting commissioner Diamantas.

title: To which hospital will Pakistan’s Supreme Court order Imran Khan transferred for medical care in August 2026?
background: Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan is imprisoned at Adiala jail. His eye condition has required specialist treatment, and concerns about his health have been central to his party’s campaign for his release.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Supreme Court’s order or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations describing its requirements.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the hospital designated in the Supreme Court’s next order, issued after the start date and during August 2026, directing Khan’s transfer from Adiala jail for hospital care.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the hospital.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Pending SC petitions (Uzma Khan; Imran May 19; early-hearing plea Jun 18) all pray for transfer to Shifa International. The SC returned earlier pleas, and the CJP said the health issue was 'not pending'. All 5 eye injections were given at PIMS (latest Jun 14), the likely middle-path venue. Essentially a coin flip.

title: Which club will Ollie Watkins join during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Ollie Watkins is an Aston Villa striker.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official club announcements or confirmed reporting from a major sports news organization establishing Watkins's completed transfer away from Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the destination club in the completed transfer. Transfer speculation or an unaccepted offer does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the destination club.
last_rationale: transfer sweep Jul24: Villa rejected Fenerbahce's GBP30-35m approach (Sun via MEN/Mirror, Jul 24), but Fenerbahce plan a London summit (Jul 23) and reportedly have personal terms. TEAMtalk (Jul 24) says Villa will be open to selling Watkins if they sign Jackson, and Man Utd are expected to make an official approach (around GBP40m) if Zirkzee leaves. Arsenal are monitoring and Roma are keen.

title: Who will win the 2026 Republican U.S. House primary featuring Florida incumbent Cory Mills?
background: Cory Mills is seeking a third term in the U.S. House of Representatives.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Florida Division of Elections results or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations identifying the primary winner.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the winner of the Florida Republican U.S. House primary in which Cory Mills is a candidate, scheduled for August 18, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: Jul 20-Aug 2: Elijah, a longtime Fox 35 Orlando anchor, added endorsements from both county sheriffs, McCollum and Sen. Wright. He launched his first TV ad, had $286K cash vs Mills's $81K, and won the Casselberry straw poll (Jul 29). Roll Call (Jul 30) reports a possible DOJ probe of Mills. Mills still has Trump's endorsement, touts unreleased NRCC/internal polls, and benefits from a split anti-Mills field with no runoff (a Cawthorn-2022-style upset remains possible).

title: Who will be the first major Ukrainian political figure to publicly call for wartime elections following Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion?
background: Ukrainian law bars elections during wartime. The presidential election has been postponed under continuing martial law, although Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s presidential term ended in May 2024.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: Identify the person credited in reliable reporting with the first public call by a major Ukrainian political figure since Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion to resume national elections while the war continues. A call solely for elections after the war ends does not qualify.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve when the qualifying statement becomes public, provided this occurs by August 31, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The politician’s full name.
last_rationale: sweep Aug4: No new call for wartime elections was found through Aug 4. The Economist (Aug 3) says there is 'no prospect of elections while the war continues' despite the Jul 31 Kyiv march over Fedorov's firing. Kuleba's Feb and Apr 2026 calls remain the best-documented qualifying statements. I swapped Fedorov for Zelenskyy, who said in Dec 2025 he was ready for elections within 60-90 days under martial law if security was guaranteed.
